# Orca plugin host API reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm generate:plugin-schemas` from src/shared/plugins. Do not edit. -->

Host API 1 (`"pluginApi": 1`). Workers call a method with `await orca.host.call(name, params)`; sandboxed panels post `{ type: 'orca-panel-action', requestId, action: name, params }` to the parent window, and only methods marked "Panels: yes" are allowed there.

Every call is checked against the capabilities the user approved, and params are validated before Orca runs anything. Mutations are recorded in the audit log as `plugin:<publisher>.<id>`.

| Method | Capability | Panels | Mutation | Since | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| [`terminal.sendText`](#terminalsendtext) | `terminal:send` | no | yes | 1.0 | Types text into one terminal named by id, optionally pressing Enter. |
| [`notifications.show`](#notificationsshow) | `notifications:show` | yes | yes | 1.0 | Shows a desktop notification. |
| [`storage.get`](#storageget) | `storage:own` | no | no | 1.0 | Reads a JSON value from the plugin's private store; null when absent. |
| [`storage.set`](#storageset) | `storage:own` | no | yes | 1.0 | Writes a JSON value to the plugin's private store. |
| [`storage.delete`](#storagedelete) | `storage:own` | no | yes | 1.0 | Removes a key from the plugin's private store. |
| [`storage.keys`](#storagekeys) | `storage:own` | no | no | 1.0 | Lists the keys in the plugin's private store. |
| [`secrets.get`](#secretsget) | `secrets:own` | no | no | 1.0 | Reads a secret from the plugin's encrypted secrets file; null when absent. |
| [`secrets.set`](#secretsset) | `secrets:own` | no | yes | 1.0 | Stores a secret in the plugin's encrypted secrets file. |
| [`secrets.delete`](#secretsdelete) | `secrets:own` | no | yes | 1.0 | Removes a secret from the plugin's encrypted secrets file. |
| [`settings.get`](#settingsget) | `settings:own` | no | no | 1.0 | Reads every setting the plugin owns. |
| [`settings.set`](#settingsset) | `settings:own` | no | yes | 1.0 | Writes one setting the plugin owns. |

### `workspace.readContext`

Branch, name and terminal ids of the focused workspace, or null when none is focused.

```ts
(params: {}) => { branch: string; displayName: string; terminals: { id: string }[] } | null
```

### `terminal.sendText`

Types text into one terminal named by id, optionally pressing Enter.

```ts
(params: { terminalId: string; text: string; enter?: boolean }) => { accepted: boolean }
```

### `notifications.show`

Shows a desktop notification.

```ts
(params: { title: string; body?: string }) => { delivered: boolean }
```

### `storage.get`

Reads a JSON value from the plugin's private store; null when absent.

```ts
(params: { key: string }) => { value: JSON }
```

### `storage.set`

Writes a JSON value to the plugin's private store.

```ts
(params: { key: string; value: JSON }) => { ok: true }
```

### `storage.delete`

Removes a key from the plugin's private store.

```ts
(params: { key: string }) => { ok: true }
```

### `storage.keys`

Lists the keys in the plugin's private store.

```ts
(params: {}) => { keys: string[] }
```

### `secrets.get`

Reads a secret from the plugin's encrypted secrets file; null when absent.

```ts
(params: { key: string }) => { value: string | null }
```

### `secrets.set`

Stores a secret in the plugin's encrypted secrets file.

```ts
(params: { key: string; value: string }) => { ok: true }
```

### `secrets.delete`

Removes a secret from the plugin's encrypted secrets file.

```ts
(params: { key: string }) => { ok: true }
```

### `settings.get`

Reads every setting the plugin owns.

```ts
(params: {}) => { settings: Record<string, JSON> }
```

### `settings.set`

Writes one setting the plugin owns.

```ts
(params: { key: string; value: JSON }) => { ok: true }
```

## Errors

A failed call rejects (workers) or answers `ok: false` (panels) with one of these codes:

- `invalid_request`: the call itself is malformed.
- `unknown_method`: the method does not exist in this Orca.
- `capability_denied`: the manifest does not declare the capability.
- `consent_required`: the plugin is disabled or the user has not approved this version.
- `panel_forbidden`: a panel called a worker-only method.
- `invalid_params`: params do not match the method; the message names the field.
- `rate_limited`: a panel sent calls faster than its budget.
- `unavailable`: the service behind the method is not running.
- `action_failed`: the method ran and failed.

## Stability and deprecation

Plugins are in Alpha: the manifest v2 format and catalog format are stable contracts; items listed as experimental in [Plugin authoring](./plugin-authoring.md#stability) may change.

- **Host API 1 is frozen.** Within `pluginApi` 1, methods, params and results only grow: a new method or a new optional param arrives with a higher `Since` minor, and nothing listed here is removed, renamed or narrowed.
- **Deprecation.** A method to be retired is marked deprecated in this table and keeps working for the rest of the major.
- **New majors.** A breaking change ships as a new `pluginApi` major beside the old one. Orca refuses a manifest whose `pluginApi` names a major it does not implement, with "update Orca", instead of loading it against the wrong API.
- **Probe, do not assume.** A method newer than the running Orca fails with `unknown_method`; check for it when you support older releases.
